LanguageData.CK_Toilet.label: toilet
LanguageData.CK_Toilet.description: DBH-style toilet. Uses 14 L per flush; colonist bladder need uses it automatically.
LanguageData.CK_SewagePipe.label: sewage pipe
LanguageData.CK_SewagePipe.description: Connects toilets to septic tanks. Does not block movement and can run under walls; drag with the left mouse button to lay a line quickly.
LanguageData.CK_SepticTank.label: septic tank
LanguageData.CK_SepticTank.description: DBH-style septic tank. Stores sewage until emptied.
